signal: Momentum.io was acquired by Salesforce, with the deal closing in March 2026

email.body1:
Cris, saw Momentum close its acquisition by Salesforce. Congratulations on the outcome.

Folding into a parent usually means a bigger number and more accounts in play than the team can cover before things settle, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Momentum off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Cris, quick follow-up for Momentum.

After a deal closes, expectations on pipeline jump faster than headcount can. Most revenue leaders don't actually know how many meetings the team needs to book to hit the new target, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Momentum needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Cris, last bit of proof for Momentum.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Momentum's reply rate likely compares to other GTM software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Cris, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating into a new parent is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Momentum either way.
